# Soul Color Test

Soul Color Test is a free web quiz for symbolic self-reflection. Quick mode uses 7 questions and Deep mode uses 16. Results include a primary color, supporting shade, strengths, growth edges, relationship style, work signals, and an action plan.

It is not a medical, mental health, hiring, or diagnostic tool.
